unverified_external_oracles.details: Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph) is strictly an astronomical ephemeris and contains no astrological Vimshottari or KP logic. The Rust implementations (xalen-vedic) and their Python bindings (xalen) pass all native Rust unit tests and 258 validation suite integration tests. Per Phase D verification standards, independent mathematical validation requires comparison against authoritative published canonical sources (e.g. K.S. Krishnamurti's KP Reader No. 1 & 2 published tables, and B.V. Raman / Indian Astronomical Ephemeris tables), rather than relying solely on the internal Rust formulas.
unverified_external_oracles.status: REQUIRES EXTERNAL CANONICAL REFERENCE TABLES (PHASE D)
